[Lohas Park Musashimurayama (AEON MALL Musashimurayama)](/e/lohas-park-musashimurayama-aeon/): Musashimurayama City, AEON MALL Musashimurayama, Tsumugu Hiroba (Dec 12 (Sat) and 13 (Sun), 2026)
